about.if-you-have-a-legal-problem-in-agr: If you have a legal problem in Agra, finding a lawyer usually means asking a relative who knows someone, or walking into the court compound and hoping for the best. National legal portals are no better — search “lawyer near me” and you will be shown advocates in Delhi or Noida who have never appeared before the Agra District Court.

about.rule-36-of-the-bar-council-of-indi: Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules restricts advertising by advocates. Listings on this site are factual entries published at the request of the advocate concerned — name, enrolment, practice areas, address and contact details — and are not intended as advertisement, solicitation or an inducement. Nothing on this website should be treated as legal advice, and reading it creates no advocate–client relationship.

about.vakil-saab-agra-exists-to-answer-o: Vakil Saab Agra exists to answer one question well: who is the right advocate for my matter, here in Agra, and how do I reach them today?

about.we-do-not-scrape-listings-from-any: We do not scrape listings from anywhere. An advocate joins only by sending us their details themselves, which means every profile here is consented to.
about.we-thought-a-city-deserves-better-: We thought a city deserves better than that. faq.a-first-consultation-in-agra-typical: A first consultation in Agra typically ranges from about ₹400 to ₹2,000, depending on the advocate’s seniority and how complex the matter is. Case fees are separate and agreed between you and the advocate. Every profile on this site shows the consultation fee upfront.
faq.a-fixed-technology-and-listing-servi: A fixed technology and listing service fee, billed in advance — monthly, half-yearly or yearly — with the optional microsite priced separately. It is not a charge per enquiry and never a share of the fee an advocate charges a client. Message us on WhatsApp for the current figures; they are sent in writing before anything is paid.
faq.advocates-are-listed-across-civil-li: Advocates are listed across Civil Lines, Sadar Bazaar, Kamla Nagar, Dayalbagh, Sikandra, Tajganj, Shahganj, Belanganj, Balkeshwar, Fatehabad Road, Trans Yamuna Colony, Loha Mandi, Khandari, Bodla, Rakabganj, Shamshabad Road, Nai Ki Mandi and the Collectorate compound.

faq.listings-are-limited-to-factual-part: Listings are limited to factual particulars — name, enrolment number, practice areas, address and contact details — of the kind contemplated by the Bar Council of India Rules. We do not publish success rates or claims of comparative superiority. If you would like any wording amended, tell us and we will change it.
faq.never-we-do-not-take-a-percentage-a-: Never. We do not take a percentage, a referral fee or a booking fee. Whatever you agree with the advocate is paid entirely to the advocate.
faq.no-the-badge-confirms-that-we-checke: No. The badge confirms that we checked the enrolment number and spoke to the advocate. It is not an endorsement of their competence or of any outcome in your case. Please satisfy yourself about credentials and suitability at the first consultation.
faq.no-there-is-no-account-system-at-all: No. There is no account system at all. The directory is a public, static website — you can search and call an advocate without giving us any personal details.
faq.no-vakil-saab-agra-covers-agra-city-: No. Vakil Saab Agra covers Agra city and Agra district only. Keeping the directory local is the whole point — a national portal will show you an advocate who has never appeared in an Agra court.
faq.no-we-publish-no-star-ratings-and-no: No. We publish no star ratings and no review counts anywhere on this site, because we have no way yet to verify that a review comes from somebody who actually instructed that advocate. We would rather show you nothing than a number we cannot stand behind. If we add reviews later they will be tied to confirmed consultations, and advocates will not be able to edit or delete them.
faq.principally-the-district-and-session: Principally the District and Sessions Court at Agra, the Family Court, the Chief Judicial Magistrate’s courts, the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, the Labour Court, the Commercial Court, the Revenue Courts and the Sub-Registrar offices. Many also appear before the Allahabad High Court in appeals and quashing petitions arising out of Agra matters.
faq.send-a-whatsapp-message-to-phone: Send a WhatsApp message to {phone} with your name, Bar Council enrolment number, years of practice, practice areas, chamber address and the number clients may call. faq.start-by-searching-your-problem-in-e: Start by searching your problem in everyday language, such as "landlord not returning deposit" or "cheque bounced". The search matches your words against the specific case types each advocate handles. If you are still unsure, call or WhatsApp us and we will point you to the right practice area free of charge.
faq.tell-us-and-we-will-look-into-it-whe: Tell us and we will look into it. Where the complaint is serious we will suspend the listing while we do so. Professional misconduct is regulated by the Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh, and a formal complaint can be made to them directly.
faq.that-is-a-matter-between-you-and-you: That is a matter between you and your advocate, but it is normal and reasonable to ask for the fee structure in writing before you engage them, including what is covered, what court fees are extra, and how additional hearings are charged.
faq.we-can-narrow-the-field-to-the-two-o: We can narrow the field to the two or three advocates whose practice fits your matter, but the choice is yours. We do not accept payment for placement, and ordering is by years in practice and how complete a profile is.

faq.yes-the-district-legal-services-auth: Yes. Several advocates listed here also take legal aid matters — this is noted on their profiles.

pricing.if-you-are-looking-for-a-lawyer-: If you are looking for a lawyer, this page is not for you — searching, filtering and contacting an advocate is free, there is no account, and we take no share of any fee you agree with them.
pricing.is-there-a-discount-for-a-group-: Is there a discount for a group of advocates?
pricing.no-and-we-never-will-the-fee-abo: No, and we never will. The fee above is the whole commercial relationship. What you agree with a client is between you and the client, and we have no visibility of it and no claim on it.
pricing.no-lock-in-on-the-monthly-plan: No lock-in on the monthly plan
pricing.no-ordering-is-by-years-in-pract: No. Ordering is by years in practice and how complete a profile is, and nothing you pay changes it. A directory that sells position is worth nothing to the person reading it, and that is the whole product.
pricing.no-the-fee-is-fixed-for-the-peri: No. The fee is fixed for the period, whether the phone rings once or fifty times. We count how often people tap call or WhatsApp so we can tell you how the listing is doing, not so we can bill you for it.
pricing.ready-or-want-to-ask-first: Ready, or want to ask first?
pricing.send-a-whatsapp-message-with-you: Send a WhatsApp message with your name, Bar Council enrolment number, years of practice, practice areas and chamber address. We confirm the enrolment, send you a draft profile to approve, and publish it — usually within two working days.
pricing.start-with-the-listing-and-add-t: Start with the listing and add the microsite at any point; you pay the microsite rate from that month onwards.
pricing.stop-whenever-you-like-the-listi: Stop whenever you like. The listing runs to the end of the month you have paid for and then comes down.
pricing.the-microsite-can-be-added-later: The microsite can be added later
pricing.we-tell-you-before-the-period-en: We tell you before the period ends. If you want to carry on, you pay again; if you do not reply, the listing simply stops at the date you paid up to.
pricing.why-is-the-microsite-priced-sepa: Why is the microsite priced separately?
pricing.yes-that-is-the-point-of-sending: Yes — that is the point of sending them. Every month you get how many people opened your profile and how many tapped call or WhatsApp, so the renewal decision is yours to make on evidence rather than on our word.
pricing.you-pay-for-the-period-before-it: You pay for the period before it starts. There is no invoice at the end of a month and no auto-charge — nothing is stored that could take money without you doing something.
privacy.advocate-names-enrolment-numbers: Advocate names, enrolment numbers, chamber addresses, practice areas, photographs and contact numbers are published on this site with the consent of the advocate concerned, who supplies them for the express purpose of being listed publicly. Any advocate may ask us to correct or remove their listing at any time by messaging us from their registered number, and we act on such requests within one working day.
privacy.because-there-is-no-registration: Because there is no registration and no lead-capture form, we do not collect your name, address, phone number, email address, case details or any documents through this website. When you call or WhatsApp an advocate from a profile page, that conversation is directly between you and them — it does not pass through us.
privacy.if-you-call-whatsapp-or-email-us: If you call, WhatsApp or email us for help choosing an advocate, we keep only what is needed to answer you, and only for as long as needed. Please do not send us case papers or confidential documents — share those only with the advocate you engage.
privacy.if-your-browser-sends-a-do-not-t: If your browser sends a “Do Not Track” signal, we count nothing at all.
privacy.like-most-websites-our-hosting-p: Like most websites, our hosting provider records standard server logs — IP address, browser type, pages requested and timestamps — for security and to keep the site running. We do not use Google Analytics or any other third-party analytics service, and this site sets no cookies at all.
privacy.profile-pages-link-to-google-map: Profile pages link to Google Maps and to WhatsApp. Those services have their own privacy policies, and we have no control over what they collect once you leave this site. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts.
privacy.vakil-saab-agra-is-a-static-webs: Vakil Saab Agra is a static website. There is no account system, no login and no enquiry form. We do not ask you for your name, phone number or email in order to search the directory, and we do not sell or rent anyone’s personal information to anybody.
privacy.we-also-keep-a-count-of-what-peo: We also keep a count of what people type into the search box, so we know which legal problems Agra is actually searching for. Search text is stored on its own with no identifier attached to it, is trimmed, and has any long run of digits stripped out first — so a phone number pasted into the box is not kept.
privacy.we-count-anonymously-how-many-ti: We count, anonymously, how many times each advocate’s profile is opened and how many times somebody taps call, WhatsApp or copy-number on it. We do this for one reason: so that we can tell the advocate how their listing is actually performing, in numbers, instead of asking them to take our word for it.
privacy.we-may-update-this-policy-from-t: We may update this policy from time to time; the date above always reflects the current version. Questions about privacy can be sent to
privacy.what-gets-recorded-is-the-kind-o: What gets recorded is the kind of action, which advocate’s profile it happened on, whether it happened in the directory or on that advocate’s own microsite, and the time. What does not get recorded, ever: your IP address, your browser’s user-agent, your location, or anything else that could identify you. No cookie is set and no personal data is stored. A random identifier is kept in your browser’s session storage purely so the same click is not counted twice within thirty seconds — it is never linked to a person, never shared, and disappears when you close the tab.
privacy.your-browser-may-store-a-small-a: Your browser may store a small amount of data locally (for example, your last search filters) so the page behaves sensibly. This stays on your device and is never sent to us.
terms.a-listing-runs-until-the-date-it-i: A listing runs until the date it is paid up to. If it is not renewed by then, the profile is removed from the directory and from the sitemap, and any microsite on its own subdomain stops serving — the address will return a not-found page rather than the site. Nothing is deleted at our end: the record is kept, and renewing brings the profile and the microsite back at the same address exactly as they were.
terms.an-advocate-may-ask-for-their-list: An advocate may ask for their listing to be taken down at any time, and we act on that within one working day.
terms.any-engagement-you-enter-into-is-a: Any engagement you enter into is a direct contract between you and the advocate. We are not a party to it, we take no commission from it, and we accept no responsibility for the advice given, the fees charged, the conduct of the advocate or the outcome of your matter. Fee arrangements, scope of work and timelines should be agreed with your advocate directly, preferably in writing.
terms.asked-for-within-seven-days-of-the: Asked for within seven days of the listing going live, the whole fee is refunded. After seven days we refund the unused whole months, calculated at the monthly rate rather than the discounted rate that was prepaid, and not counting any month already begun — the discount is what the longer commitment bought, so it does not survive that commitment being cut short. A microsite is refunded on the same basis. Refunds go back the way the payment came, within fourteen working days.
terms.by-using-vakilsaabagra-com-you-acc: By using vakilsaabagra.in you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.
terms.cancelling-stops-the-next-month-s-: Cancelling stops the next month's billing. The current month is not refunded, and the listing runs to the end of it.
terms.listing-fees-and-what-they-do-not-: Listing fees, and what they do not promise
terms.listings-on-this-site-consist-of-f: Listings on this site consist of factual particulars supplied by the advocate concerned — name, enrolment number, practice areas, chamber address and contact details. They are published at the advocate’s request and are not intended to be, and should not be construed as, advertisement, solicitation, inducement or an invitation for professional work within the meaning of the Bar Council of India Rules. There is no advertisement of success rates or claims of comparative superiority anywhere on this site.
terms.questions-about-these-terms-may-be: Questions about these terms may be sent to
terms.the-service-fee-is-payable-in-adva: The service fee is payable in advance for the period chosen — monthly, half-yearly or yearly — and the current figures are sent in writing before any payment is taken. The fee pays for building and publishing the listing, keeping it available and keeping the site running.
terms.these-terms-are-governed-by-the-la: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Agra, Uttar Pradesh shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from the use of this website.
terms.to-the-extent-permitted-by-law-vak: To the extent permitted by law, Vakil Saab Agra shall not be liable for any loss or damage — direct, indirect or consequential — arising from your use of this website, from reliance on any listing, or from any engagement with a listed advocate.
terms.vakil-saab-agra-is-a-technology-an: Vakil Saab Agra is a technology and listing service. We build, host and maintain a listing — and, where taken, a microsite — in return for a fixed service fee agreed in advance. We are not a law firm, we do not practise law, and we are not an intermediary between an advocate and a client. We do not refer or recommend any advocate to any person, and we take no share, commission, referral fee or other part of any fee an advocate charges a client. Nothing an advocate pays us is calculated by reference to enquiries received or work obtained.
terms.vakil-saab-agra-is-an-information-: Vakil Saab Agra is an information directory. We are not a law firm, we do not practise law, and we do not provide legal advice, opinions or representation. Nothing on this website is legal advice, and no advocate–client relationship is created between you and us — or between you and any listed advocate — by reading these pages or by contacting us.
terms.we-are-not-a-law-firm: We are not a law firm
terms.we-do-not-guarantee-any-number-of-: We do not guarantee any number of enquiries, calls, clients or instructions, and we make no representation that a listing will produce work. The counts we report to an advocate — profile views and contact taps — describe what happened; they are not a forecast and not a promise. An advocate who needs a guaranteed volume of work should not buy a listing.
terms.we-may-end-a-listing-ourselves-wit: We may end a listing ourselves, with a pro-rata refund of the unused whole months, if the enrolment details cannot be verified, if the advocate asks us to publish something we consider misleading or outside what the Bar Council of India Rules permit, or if the advocate no longer practises at Agra.
terms.we-publish-no-star-ratings-review-: We publish no star ratings, review counts or any other measure of an advocate's performance, and nothing on this site should be read as a prediction of, or a guarantee about, the outcome of any matter.
terms.we-verify-bar-council-enrolment-de: We verify Bar Council enrolment details before publishing a profile, and we speak to each advocate directly. Even so, details such as fees, availability and chamber address can change. We make no warranty that any listing is complete, current or error-free, and you should independently satisfy yourself about an advocate’s credentials, experience and suitability before engaging them.
terms.we-will-normally-remind-an-advocat: We will normally remind an advocate before the date, but the responsibility for renewing is the advocate's, and a listing may go offline on expiry without further notice.
terms.what-happens-if-a-listing-is-not-r: What happens if a listing is not renewed
terms.what-we-are-for-advocates-who-list: What we are, for advocates who list with us
terms.you-may-use-this-directory-to-find: You may use this directory to find and contact an advocate for a genuine legal requirement. You may not scrape, copy or republish listings in bulk, use contact details for marketing or spam, misrepresent yourself, or attempt to disrupt the site.
